name: Skill Token Usage Dashboard

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["evaluation-run"]
    types: [completed]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  collect-token-data:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Setup PowerShell
        uses: actions/setup-powershell@v2
        
      - name: Download workflow artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: artifact-*
          path: ./artifacts
          merge-multiple: true
          
      - name: Generate token usage data
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Create data directory if it doesn't exist
          if (!(Test-Path "./data")) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path "./data"
          }
          
          # Run the token data generation script
          .\eng\dashboard\generate-token-data.ps1 -ArtifactPath "./artifacts" -OutputPath "./data/token-usage.json"
          
      - name: Upload token data
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: token-usage-data
          path: ./data/token-usage.json
          
  generate-dashboard:
    needs: collect-token-data
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Download token data
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: token-usage-data
          path: ./data
          
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install chart.js
        
      - name: Generate benchmark data with tokens
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          .\eng\dashboard\generate-benchmark-data.ps1 -TokenDataPath "./data/token-usage.json" -OutputPath "./data/benchmark-data.json"
          
      - name: Upload dashboard data
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dashboard-data
          path: ./data/benchmark-data.json
          
  deploy-dashboard:
    needs: generate-dashboard
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Download dashboard data
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dashboard-data
          path: ./data
          
      - name: Setup Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v4
        
      - name: Build dashboard HTML
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Create dashboard directory if it doesn't exist
          if (!(Test-Path "./dashboard")) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path "./dashboard"
          }
          
          # Copy static files
          Copy-Item -Path "./eng/dashboard/dashboard.html" -Destination "./dashboard/index.html"
          Copy-Item -Path "./eng/dashboard/dashboard.js" -Destination "./dashboard/dashboard.js"
          Copy-Item -Path "./eng/dashboard/token-usage.js" -Destination "./dashboard/token-usage.js"
          
          # Add token data to dashboard
          $tokenData = Get-Content -Path "./data/benchmark-data.json" -Raw
          $htmlContent = Get-Content -Path "./dashboard/index.html" -Raw
          $updatedHtml = $htmlContent -replace '<!-- TOKEN_DATA_PLACEHOLDER -->', "<script>const tokenData = $tokenData;</script>"
          Set-Content -Path "./dashboard/index.html" -Value $updatedHtml
          
      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: './dashboard'
          
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
